column1: # A shipped migration's BYTES are its contract: the runner checksums the whole file
# text, so editing one (a comment included) bricks every node that already ran it.
# Rows are appended when a migration is ADDED. A row is never edited.
# v62.0.0 (slice E2b): edition 1 (V001..V216) is retired — a v62 node deletes an
# edition-1 store — and its rows with it. Edition 2 begins at the V300 baseline.
# v62.0.0 (slice J0): V300 is unshipped; its two rows are re-pinned once, for
# `ceg_statements.admitted_us` (the statement serve cursor). From the v62 tag
# on, V300's bytes are its contract.
# v62.0.0 (X2 pass 4c, BF9): re-pinned again over the round-3 V300 edits (the pin was
# already stale at the round-3 base, P1); still unshipped.
